name: agent-authoring-toolkit
description: A suite for authoring Claude Code artifacts: reviewing-claude-skills reviews a skill in two passes — structure first, stopping at a structural verdict when the workflow's shape fails, otherwise a full sweep ending in a computed verdict that honors the skill's recorded waivers; reviewing-claude-subagents reviews a subagent definition the same way, grading fit-for-purpose first; improving-claude-skills loops the skill review autonomously — review → apply every blocking finding → commit → re-review — until the verdict is acceptable, the findings plateau, or the round cap is hit, asking only one question: the intent brief at kickoff.
